label: GCR atmospheric shielding proxy
kind: Stargazing derived planning model; not NASA surface radiation measurements
referenceColumnSource: Townsend et al. (2011), warm reference atmosphere, 16 g/cm2; Table 1, phi=417 MV, aluminum=0. Vertical-column ratio only; not angularly integrated surface dose.
limitations: Dimensionless ratio relative to the 16 g/cm2 reference, using linear interpolation of Table 1 at vertical atmospheric column.
Fixed exponential atmosphere and solar modulation scenario; no observation date, forecast, solar particle event or seasonal pressure prediction.
Not a full transport calculation: angular integration, regolith secondaries, terrain shielding, equipment and human exposure limits are not evaluated. No mSv or safety threshold is assigned.
MOLA areoid heights are used as an approximate altitude reference for the fixed atmosphere. This derived proxy is not a NASA-issued radiation map.
routingWeightBasis: Stargazing engineering scenario: add 4 * proxy to dimensionless terrain/temperature cell cost; not a NASA recommended safety weight.
